tools.name: cxt_search_shipments
tools.description: Search orders and route stops by place, address, city, state, postal code, order template, or only by date range. tracking_type says which field search_criteria is matched against: Location (origin/destination or stop name), Address, City, State, Postal (zip or zip+4), Template (order template name)

tools.name: cxt_list_recent_orders
tools.description: The most recent orders of the signed-in INTERNET user (user type INET; the orders of their account). Costs 1 API credit with the vendor. POST /v2/Shipments/Summaries with numRecentOrders.

tools.name: cxt_get_order
tools.description: One on-demand order with its status, confirmation, pickup, delivery and proof-of-delivery details, as an INTERNET user sees it (sign in with user type INET). Optionally with the itemized charges. Operations App users should use cxt_get_dispatch_order. Costs 1 API credit with the vendor. GET /v2/Orde

tools.name: cxt_get_dispatch_order
tools.description: One on-demand order with itemized charges, as an OPERATIONS APP (X Dispatch) user sees it (sign in with user type XDISPATCH): addresses, times, driver, status events, proof of delivery. Costs 1 API credit with the vendor. GET /v2/Dispatch/Orders/{onDemandOrderId}.

tools.name: cxt_get_planning_limits
tools.description: The itinerary planning limits of this X Dispatch system: maxAllowedStops (shipments x 2), maxAllowedLocations and maxAllowedPlaceholders. Needs an Operations App user with the ITINERARY_PLANNING_ACCESS permission. GET /v3/ItineraryPlanning/Settings.

tools.name: cxt_validate_drivers
tools.description: Check whether drivers are available to be planned: for each driver id, vehicle violations (for example an expired inspection) and HR violations (for example not scheduled), each with isBypassable. Changes nothing. Needs ITINERARY_PLANNING_ACCESS. POST /v3/ItineraryPlanning/Orders/Drivers/Validate.

tools.name: cxt_validate_driver_for_orders
tools.description: Check one driver against specific orders: vehicle violations, HR violations and capability violations (for example Hazmat or Lift Gate that the driver lacks). Changes nothing. Needs ITINERARY_PLANNING_ACCESS. POST /v3/ItineraryPlanning/Orders/Drivers/{driverId}/Validate.

tools.name: cxt_plan_orders
tools.description: Generate a proposed itinerary that assigns on-demand orders to drivers (pickup and delivery stops in sequence, with times, distance and unassigned stops). This only PROPOSES a plan: nothing is dispatched until cxt_save_order_plan is called. Needs ITINERARY_PLANNING_ACCESS. Check the limits with cxt_

tools.name: cxt_optimize_order_plan
tools.description: Re-optimize a single driver's plan after manual changes (proposal only: nothing is dispatched until cxt_save_order_plan). Needs ITINERARY_PLANNING_ACCESS. POST /v3/ItineraryPlanning/Orders/Optimize.

tools.name: cxt_plan_routes
tools.description: Generate a proposed re-sequencing of the stops of existing routes for one route date (stops move between the output routes, with times, distance and unassigned stops). Proposal only: nothing changes until cxt_save_route_plan is called. Needs ITINERARY_PLANNING_ACCESS. POST /v3/ItineraryPlanning/Rout

tools.name: cxt_optimize_route_plan
tools.description: Re-optimize a single route after manual changes (proposal only: nothing changes until cxt_save_route_plan). Needs ITINERARY_PLANNING_ACCESS. POST /v3/ItineraryPlanning/Routes/{postDate}/Optimize.

tools.name: cxt_save_order_plan
tools.description: COMMIT an order plan: assigns the orders to the drivers and DISPATCHES them (drivers receive the work in the driver app; customers may be notified by the system's own status rules). findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: cxt_track_shipments, cxt_search_shipments, cxt_list_recent_orders, cxt_validate_drivers, cxt_validate_driver_for_orders, cxt_plan_orders, cxt_save_order_plan · Private data: cxt_track_shipments, cxt_search_shipments · Public sink: cxt_track_shipments, cxt_search_shipments, cxt_list_recent_orders, cxt_validate_drivers, cxt_validate_driver_for_orders, cxt_plan_orders, cxt_optimize_order_plan, cxt_plan_routes, cxt_optimize_route_plan, cxt_save_order_plan, cxt_save_route_plan.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: cxt_track_shipments, cxt_search_shipments, cxt_list_recent_orders, cxt_validate_drivers, cxt_validate_driver_for_orders, cxt_plan_orders, cxt_save_order_plan · Private data: cxt_track_shipments, cxt_search_shipments · Public sink: cxt_track_shipments, cxt_search_shipments, cxt_list_recent_orders, cxt_validate_drivers, cxt_validate_driver_for_orders, cxt_plan_orders, cxt_optimize_order_plan, cxt_plan_routes, cxt_optimize_route_plan, cxt_save_order_plan, cxt_save_route_plan

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
